entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right, we'd better go pawn off that[n]gold medal!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: *sigh* Boy, I'm awfully busy. These dirty[n]dishes just keep piling higher and higher!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: If only someone were around to lend me[n]a hand—maybe... a nice young man living[n]here on my dime?
